jumps.name: Unilever Foods acquisition - UK CMA regulatory block/delay/remedies
jumps.reason: A proposed, transformational acquisition of the majority of Unilever's foods business is under active UK competition-authority investigation opened 2026-09-16, outcome uncertain (clearance, remedies, or block) and likely debt-funded on an already-leveraged balance sheet (net debt/EBITDA 3.12x); the note's invalidation triggers include the CMA outcome and financing keeping net debt/EBITDA at or below 3.5x.
jumps.cite: note research/MKC/2026-10-09.md section 2 (Quality) and section 6 (Unusual items); fact sheet News & sentiment Reuters headline 2026-09-16 'McCormick and Unilever food deal faces UK competition scrutiny'; evaluation Bear case.

annual_probability.cite: The CMA investigation is already active since 2026-09-16 and typically produces a decision within about a year, so an outcome event is near-certain within the 12-month horizon; comparable M&A-scale events are rare in the 5y history (only 1 'M&A Announcement' event-week in mc-inputs.json event_weeks, 2025-08-18), i.e. this is a one-off live event rather than a recurring base-rate risk.

impact.cite: mc-inputs.json all_weekly_moves week '2026-09-14' = -0.0507, the trading week containing the 2026-09-16 Reuters report of the CMA investigation.

jumps.name: Quarterly earnings reaction
jumps.reason: MKC's quarterly results drive outsized weekly moves (largest 5-year weekly fall of -14.15% coincided with the Q3 2023 earnings week); Q3 2026 results released 2026-10-01 already showed GAAP profit falling to $97.6m from $225.5m a year earlier even as sales rose, a pattern of earnings-quality surprises that can recur and swing the stock sharply around results.
jumps.cite: fact sheet News & sentiment WSJ headline 2026-10-01 'McCormick Posts Lower Profit on Higher Sales'; note research/MKC/2026-10-09.md section 3 (Valuation); mc-inputs.json event_weeks Q3 2023 entry.

annual_probability.cite: Earnings are released on a certain quarterly cadence (4x/year; mc-inputs.json event_weeks lists one Q1-Q4 report each fiscal year), so at least one such reaction week occurring within the next 12 months is effectively certain; the impact value captures the magnitude of the largest observed single-quarter reaction.

impact.cite: mc-inputs.json analogues.largest_falls / event_weeks: week '2023-10-02' = -0.1415, the Q3 2023 earnings-release week, the single largest weekly fall in the 5-year history.
